field.rubricHint: Write it in markdown: for each criterion, describe every level of the score.
field.promptTemplateHint: Use all four variables {{rubric}}, {{samples}}, {{task}}, {{response}}; no other variable or syntax. They are replaced by the rubric, the samples, the task and the candidate's answer when grading.
field.resultSchema: JSON Schema of the AI's result
field.resultSchemaHint: It must declare a property for every criterion code. It may refer only to itself ("$ref": "#/..."); no $id.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.hint: Each criterion has a code (used in the AI's result), a name and a scale: lowest, highest and step (the step divides the range from lowest to highest).
criteria.label: Criterion {{n}}
criteria.name: Criterion name

samples.title: Scored samples
samples.hint: The AI calibrates against scored examples. Each has a band, its content as text or as the id of a recording or image file, and the examiner's commentary.
samples.label: Sample {{n}}
samples.mediaId: Or the id of a recording or image file

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.hint: Run the saved skill on a sample answer to see what the AI returns. No score is kept.
dryRun.unavailable: A dry run needs the AI grader, which is not built yet. The skill is saved and reviewed as usual.

new.title: New grading skill
new.description: A grading skill is the rubric, criteria, prompt and samples the AI uses to grade one Writing or Speaking question type.
new.noneTitle: No question type to write a skill for
new.none: You may not write a skill for any Writing or Speaking type in this context.

edit.inReviewNote: This version is waiting for review and is locked.
